reg_deadline.en: Registration closed on Monday, October 5, 2026. Not sure you're registered? Check the Secretary of State's voter lookup.
reg_deadline.es: El registro cerró el lunes 5 de octubre de 2026. ¿No sabes si estás registrado? Revisa la búsqueda de votantes de la Secretaría de Estado.

mail_request.en: Your county election commission must receive your written request by Saturday, October 24, 2026. You can send it by mail or email, with your signature.
mail_request.es: La comisión electoral de tu condado (county election commission) debe recibir tu solicitud por escrito a más tardar el sábado 24 de octubre de 2026. Puedes enviarla por correo postal o por correo electrónico, con tu firma.
mail_request.quote: Absentee Ballot Request Deadline Saturday, October 24, 2026
mail_request.en_after: Requests closed on October 24. You can still vote early in person through Thursday, October 29, or at your polling place on Election Day.
mail_request.es_after: Las solicitudes cerraron el 24 de octubre. Todavía puedes votar por anticipado en persona hasta el jueves 29 de octubre, o en tu lugar de votación el Día de las Elecciones.

mail_return.en: Your county election commission must receive your ballot by the close of polls on Tuesday, November 3, 2026. A postmark isn't enough. Send it by mail or a carrier such as FedEx or UPS. You can't hand it in.
mail_return.es: La comisión electoral de tu condado (county election commission) debe recibir tu boleta antes de que cierren las urnas el martes 3 de noviembre de 2026. El matasellos no basta. Envíala por correo postal o por una paquetería como FedEx o UPS. No puedes entregarla en persona.
mail_return.quote: You must mail your ballot in time for your county election commission to receive it no later than the close of polls on Election Day. You must return your ballot by mail (USPS, FedEx, UPS, etc.). Hand delivery or handing it to a poll worker during early voting or on Election Day is not permitted.

early_hours.en: Early voting ends Thursday, October 29. Your county election commission sets the sites and hours, including any Saturday hours. Find them on GoVoteTN.gov or in the GoVoteTN app.
early_hours.es: La votación anticipada termina el jueves 29 de octubre. La comisión electoral de tu condado fija los lugares y los horarios, incluidos los sábados. Búscalos en GoVoteTN.gov o en la app GoVoteTN.
early_hours.quote: Early voting for the November 3 election is from October 14 through October 29. ... Although closed from voting on holidays, a person may vote early on any Saturday that falls during this time frame. ... For details regarding times and early voting locations, a person must contact the local county election commission office.
early_hours.en_after: Early voting ended October 29. Vote at your assigned polling place on Election Day. Find it on GoVoteTN.gov.
early_hours.es_after: La votación anticipada terminó el 29 de octubre. Vota en el lugar de votación que te corresponde el Día de las Elecciones. Búscalo en GoVoteTN.gov.

cure.notes: No absentee cure process or deadline found on sos.tn.gov.

in_person.en: Vote early at your county election commission office or a satellite site it opens. You don't need a reason. On Election Day, vote at your assigned polling place.
in_person.es: Vota por anticipado en la oficina de la comisión electoral de tu condado o en un centro satélite que abra. No necesitas dar una razón. El Día de las Elecciones, vota en el lugar de votación que te corresponde.
in_person.quote: To vote early, a person must appear in person at either the County Election Commission office or at a satellite voting location opened by the county election commission.

first_time.en: Moved within your county? Go to any early voting site in your county through Thursday, October 29. You can update your address and vote there. Moved to a different county? Your registration doesn't move with you. You had to register in your new county by October 5 to vote in this election.
first_time.es: ¿Te mudaste dentro de tu condado? Ve a cualquier centro de votación anticipada de tu condado hasta el jueves 29 de octubre. Ahí puedes actualizar tu dirección y votar. ¿Te mudaste a otro condado? Tu registro no se traslada contigo. Tenías que registrarte en tu nuevo condado a más tardar el 5 de octubre para votar en esta elección.
first_time.quote: The voter may go to any early voting location within their county to update their address and vote. ... If you move to a different county, it is not considered an update. Your registration does not transfer to other counties in Tennessee. ... the voter must register no later than thirty (30) days before the election.
first_time.en_after: Moved within your county and haven't updated your address? On Election Day, you sign an affidavit, then vote at your new polling place or a central site your county picks. Moved to a different county? Your registration doesn't move with you. You had to register in your new county by October 5 to vote in this election.
first_time.es_after: ¿Te mudaste dentro de tu condado y no has actualizado tu dirección? El Día de las Elecciones firmas una declaración jurada y luego votas en tu nuevo lugar de votación o en un lugar central que elija tu condado. ¿Te mudaste a otro condado? Tu registro no se traslada contigo. Tenías que registrarte en tu nuevo condado a más tardar el 5 de octubre para votar en esta elección.
first_time.notes: Replaces the old line from how-to-early-vote-in-person ('change his or her address of registration and vote in the same voting location'), which didn't say it applies only to moves within the county. After-text from the same page: 'the voter must complete an affidavit before being allowed to vote. The voter will be required to vote either at their new polling location or at a central location designated by the county election commission office.' Read in Chrome.

locator_label.en: Voter Registration Information Lookup (Tennessee Secretary of State)
locator_label.es: Voter Registration Information Lookup (Secretaría de Estado de Tennessee)

rule.en: The state's voter lookup shows your early voting and Election Day information, your polling place, and your absentee ballot status. The free GoVoteTN app has polling places, hours and sample ballots too.
rule.es: La búsqueda de votantes del estado muestra tu información de votación anticipada y del Día de las Elecciones, tu lugar de votación y el estado de tu boleta de voto en ausencia. La app gratuita GoVoteTN también tiene lugares de votación, horarios y boletas de muestra.
rule.quote: This tool allows voters to review their registration information, track absentee ballots, see early voting and Election Day information, and find their polling place.

en: Tennessee driver's license with your photo
U.S. passport
Photo ID from the Tennessee Department of Safety and Homeland Security
Photo ID from the federal or Tennessee state government
U.S. military photo ID
Tennessee handgun carry permit with your photo
es: Licencia de conducir de Tennessee con tu foto
Pasaporte de EE. UU.
Identificación con foto del Departamento de Seguridad y Seguridad Nacional de Tennessee (Department of Safety and Homeland Security)
Identificación con foto del gobierno federal o del gobierno estatal de Tennessee
Identificación militar de EE. UU. con foto
Permiso de portación de armas de Tennessee (handgun carry permit) con tu foto
accepted.quote: Any of the following IDs may be used, even if expired:

expired.en: An expired ID from the list still works. First-time voter who registered by mail or online? If your ID is expired, also bring a current utility bill, bank statement, government check, paycheck or other government document with your name and address. College IDs, city or county IDs, and IDs from other states don't count.
expired.es: Una identificación vencida de la lista sí sirve. ¿Votas por primera vez y te registraste por correo o en línea? Si tu identificación está vencida, lleva también un recibo de servicios reciente, un estado de cuenta bancario, un cheque del gobierno, un talón de pago u otro documento del gobierno con tu nombre y dirección. No sirven las credenciales universitarias, las identificaciones de la ciudad o del condado ni las de otros estados.
expired.quote: Any of the following IDs may be used, even if expired: ... Photo IDs not issued by the federal or Tennessee state government are NOT acceptable. This includes county or city issued photo IDs, such as library cards, and photo IDs issued by other states.

without.en: Forgot your photo ID? You vote a provisional ballot. Then you have two business days, through Thursday, November 5, to show a valid photo ID at your county election commission office.
without.es: ¿Se te olvidó tu identificación con foto? Votas con una boleta provisional. Luego tienes dos días hábiles, hasta el jueves 5 de noviembre, para mostrar una identificación con foto válida en la oficina de la comisión electoral de tu condado.
without.quote: You will then have two (2) business days after Election Day to return to the election commission office to show a valid photo ID.
without.notes: November 5 is two business days after Tuesday, November 3. Re-read node/149 in Chrome Oct 28.

who.en: You can vote absentee by mail in Tennessee if you:
who.es: Puedes votar en ausencia por correo en Tennessee si:
who.quote: You can vote absentee by-mail if you fall under one of the following categories:

en: are 60 or older
will be outside your county during all of early voting and all day on Election Day
are hospitalized, ill or physically disabled and can't get to your polling place
care for someone who is hospitalized, ill or disabled
or your spouse are a full-time student at an accredited college or university outside your county
live in a nursing home, assisted living facility or home for the aged outside your county
are a candidate in the election
observe a religious holiday that keeps you from voting in person during early voting and on Election Day
serve as an Election Day official or work for the election commission
can't vote in person because of jury duty
have a disability and an inaccessible polling place
or your spouse have a commercial driver license (CDL) or TWIC card, will be working outside your county or the state during early voting and Election Day hours, and have no address there to get mail
are in the military or a U.S. citizen living overseas
are on the permanent absentee list
es: tienes 60 años o más
vas a estar fuera de tu condado durante toda la votación anticipada y todo el Día de las Elecciones
estás en el hospital o tienes una enfermedad o una discapacidad física, y no puedes ir a tu lugar de votación
cuidas a una persona que está en el hospital, enferma o tiene una discapacidad
tú o tu cónyuge estudian tiempo completo en una universidad acreditada fuera de tu condado
vives en un asilo de ancianos, una residencia de vida asistida o un hogar para personas mayores fuera de tu condado
eres candidato o candidata en la elección
observas una festividad religiosa que te impide votar en persona durante la votación anticipada y el Día de las Elecciones
trabajas en la elección el Día de las Elecciones o para la comisión electoral
no puedes votar en persona por servir como jurado
tienes una discapacidad y tu lugar de votación no es accesible

tú o tu cónyuge tienen licencia de conducir comercial (CDL) o tarjeta TWIC, van a trabajar fuera de tu condado o del estado durante el horario de la votación anticipada y del Día de las Elecciones, y no tienen ahí una dirección donde recibir correo
eres militar, o tienes la ciudadanía de EE. UU. y vives en el extranjero
estás en la lista permanente de voto en ausencia
who_list.quote: You are sixty (60) years of age or older.

witness.notes: The absentee guide lists what the request must contain (including the voter's signature) but says nothing about signing or witnessing the ballot envelope.

cure.notes: No cure process found on sos.tn.gov.

dropbox.en: You can't drop off a mail ballot in Tennessee. Send it by mail or a carrier such as FedEx or UPS. Poll workers can't take it during early voting or on Election Day.
dropbox.es: En Tennessee no puedes entregar en persona una boleta por correo. Envíala por correo postal o por una paquetería como FedEx o UPS. Los trabajadores electorales no pueden recibirla durante la votación anticipada ni el Día de las Elecciones.
dropbox.quote: You must return your ballot by mail (USPS, FedEx, UPS, etc.). Hand delivery or handing it to a poll worker during early voting or on Election Day is not permitted.

gear.en: Leave the campaign shirts and gear at home. Voters wearing campaign clothing or paraphernalia aren't allowed within 100 feet of a polling place entrance, where campaign materials and asking for votes are banned.
gear.es: Deja en casa las camisetas y los artículos de campaña. A los votantes con ropa o artículos de campaña no se les permite estar a menos de 100 pies de la entrada de un lugar de votación, donde están prohibidos el material de campaña y pedir el voto.
gear.quote: Voters wearing campaign-related clothing or paraphernalia will not be allowed within the 100-foot boundary.

phone.en: You can use your phone inside the polling place to look up voting information, and your county can ask you to silence it. You can't make calls, record, or take photos or video while you're inside, so no ballot photos at the polls. State law doesn't address photos of a mail ballot. Take your sticker photo after you leave.
phone.es: Puedes usar tu celular dentro del lugar de votación para consultar información sobre tu voto, y tu condado puede pedirte que lo silencies. No puedes hacer llamadas, grabar ni tomar fotos o video mientras estés adentro, así que no hay fotos de la boleta en el lugar de votación. La ley estatal no habla de fotos de una boleta por correo. Tómale la foto a tu sticker cuando salgas.
phone.quote: (b) Any voter using a mobile electronic or communication device as allowed in subsection (a) shall be prohibited from using the device for telephone conversations, recording, or taking photographs or videos while inside the polling place.
phone.notes: Quote is T.C.A. 2-7-142 as printed in Attorney General Opinion 16-49 (Dec 22, 2016), which upholds it. Same text on FindLaw 'current as of January 02, 2024' (not an official host, used only to confirm no later change). SB0600 (2017, 110th GA), which would have amended 2-7-142, stalled in Senate State and Local Government (wapp.capitol.tn.gov BillInfo). No 2025-2026 amendment found. Mail-ballot photos: nothing official found.

line.en: Polls close at 8 p.m. Eastern or 7 p.m. Central, depending on your county. If you're in line when polls close, stay in line. You'll be allowed to vote.
line.es: Los lugares de votación cierran a las 8 p. m., hora del Este, o a las 7 p. m., hora del Centro, según tu condado. Si estás en la fila cuando cierran, no te salgas. Te dejarán votar.
line.quote: If you are in line at the time the polls close, you will be allowed to vote.

tradition.en: For 2026, the Tennessee Secretary of State made a special America 250 I Voted sticker, with patriotic artwork for the country's 250th anniversary. The state said it would be at polling places during this year's elections.
tradition.es: Para 2026, la Secretaría de Estado de Tennessee hizo un sticker especial de I Voted por America 250, con arte patriótico por los 250 años del país. El estado dijo que estaría en los lugares de votación durante las elecciones de este año.
tradition.quote: The special America 250 sticker, which will be available at polling locations during upcoming elections, features patriotic artwork recognizing the nation's semiquincentennial and serves as a reminder of the enduring importance of civic engagement.

provisional.en: If you say you're registered in your county but your name isn't on the list, you can vote a provisional ballot. You fill out a voter registration form, show proof of your address and sign an affidavit. It counts if the county finds you should have been registered in that precinct. Tennessee doesn't have Election Day registration. No photo ID? You also vote a provisional ballot, and you have until Thursday, November 5, to show a valid photo ID at your county election commission office.
provisional.es: Si dices que estás registrado en tu condado pero tu nombre no está en la lista, puedes votar con una boleta provisional. Llenas un formulario de registro de votante, muestras un comprobante de tu dirección y firmas una declaración jurada. Se cuenta si el condado determina que debías estar registrado en ese precinto. Tennessee no tiene registro el Día de las Elecciones. ¿No tienes identificación con foto? También votas con una boleta provisional, y tienes hasta el jueves 5 de noviembre para mostrar una identificación con foto válida en la oficina de la comisión electoral de tu condado.
provisional.quote: A person shall be entitled to vote a provisional ballot under the procedures of this section if the voter claims to be properly registered in the county and eligible to vote at the precinct in the election, but whose eligibility cannot be determined by the computer signature list ... Nothing in this section shall be construed to allow election day voter registration.
provisional.notes: Tenn. Code 2-7-112(a)(3), in the General Assembly's code bill (official reenactment, dated 11/15/24), read by curl Oct 30. sos.tn.gov blocks curl and has no name-not-on-the-list page we found. The photo ID line keeps the Oct 28 read of sos.tn.gov/node/149 ('two (2) business days after Election Day').

line.en: You can still vote. If you're in line when polls close, at 8 p.m. Eastern or 7 p.m. Central depending on your county, you'll be allowed to vote.
line.es: Todavía puedes votar. Si estás en la fila cuando cierran las urnas, a las 8 p. m., hora del Este, o a las 7 p. m., hora del Centro, según tu condado, te dejarán votar.
line.quote: All polls close at 8 p.m. EDT / 7 p.m. CDT. If you are in line at the time the polls close, you will be allowed to vote.

track.en: Use the state's Voter Registration Information Lookup to track your absentee ballot. It also shows your registration and polling place.
track.es: Usa la búsqueda de votantes del estado (Voter Registration Information Lookup) para seguir tu boleta de voto en ausencia. También muestra tu registro y tu lugar de votación.
track.quote: This tool allows voters to review their registration information, track absentee ballots, see early voting and Election Day information, and find their polling place.

late_mail.en: It may be. Your county election commission must receive it by the time polls close on Tuesday, November 3, and a postmark doesn't count. You can only send it by mail or a carrier such as FedEx or UPS. You can't hand it in at the office or give it to a poll worker.
late_mail.es: Puede que sí. La comisión electoral de tu condado (county election commission) debe recibirla antes de que cierren los lugares de votación el martes 3 de noviembre, y el matasellos no cuenta. Solo puedes enviarla por correo o por una empresa de mensajería, como FedEx o UPS. No puedes entregarla en persona en la oficina ni dársela a un trabajador electoral.
late_mail.quote: You must mail your ballot in time for your county election commission to receive it no later than the close of polls on Election Day. You must return your ballot by mail (USPS, FedEx, UPS, etc.). Hand delivery or handing it to a poll worker during early voting or on Election Day is not permitted.
late_mail.notes: Pass 2 Oct 30, read by curl. Same rule on sos.tn.gov/elections/guides/guide-to-absentee-voting (dates.mail_return).

notes: Read October 21, 2026 in Chrome (sos.tn.gov returns a block page to curl). Pages: GoVoteTN voter page, 2026 Elections Calendar, Guide to Absentee Voting, Voter ID Requirements, FAQ node 149 (no photo ID), How to Early Vote In Person, August 4, 2026 'Everything Voters Need to Know' press release (polls close, line, 100-foot rule), July 15, 2026 America 250 sticker release. EARLY VOTING DATES FOR states.js (Tennessee is unchecked): Wednesday, October 14 to Thursday, October 29, 2026. Source https://sos.tn.gov/elections/calendar: 'Early Voting Wednesday, October 14 – Thursday, October 29, 2026'. Also on https://sos.tn.gov/govotetn: 'Early Voting for the November 3 Election: October 14 through October 29'. Sites and hours are set by each county election commission (GoVoteTN app, https://govote.tnsos.gov/). The polls and 100-foot rules come from the August 2026 election press release; no November release was found, and they describe state law, not that election alone. No local_offices_url: the SOS county commission list is on tnsos.org, which the validator's OFFICIAL pattern rejects (https://tnsos.org/elections/election_commissions.php, linked from sos.tn.gov/govotetn); add it to ALLOW_HOSTS if wanted. Mail return: by mail or carrier only, received by close of polls; no hand delivery, so no drop boxes. The early voting page also says early voting 'typically begins twenty (20) days before an election and ends five (5) days before'; not used, since the calendar gives the dates.

hours.en: Each county sets its opening time. Polls close at 8 p.m. in Eastern Time counties and 7 p.m. in Central Time counties, the same moment statewide.
hours.es: Cada condado fija su hora de apertura. Los lugares de votación cierran a las 8 p. m. en los condados con hora del Este y a las 7 p. m. en los condados con hora del Centro, al mismo tiempo en todo el estado.
hours.quote: On Election Day, poll opening times vary by county. Voters should check their polling location and hours before heading to the polls. All polls close at 8 p.m. EDT / 7 p.m. CDT.
